evals.prompt: Create a new SAP presentation with a cover slide titled 'Q4 2026 Business Review' and save it as quarterly_review.pptx
evals.expected_output: A PPTX file created with SAP branding and a cover slide with the specified title
assertions: File is a valid PowerPoint file

evals.prompt: Create an SAP presentation with these slides: a Cover A slide titled 'Product Launch', an Agenda A slide, and a Title and Text slide about features. Save as product_launch.pptx
evals.expected_output: A PPTX file with 3 slides using the specified layouts
assertions: First slide uses Cover A layout
Second slide uses Agenda A layout
Third slide uses Title and Text layout

evals.prompt: Read the presentation at evals/files/sample.pptx and tell me how many slides it has and what layouts are used
evals.expected_output: JSON or text output showing slide count and layout information
assertions: Output includes layout names for each slide
Format is structured (JSON or clear text)

evals.prompt: Add a new 'Thank You A' slide to evals/files/sample.pptx and save as updated_presentation.pptx
evals.expected_output: Modified presentation with an additional Thank You slide
assertions: Has one more slide than the original
Last slide uses Thank You A layout

evals.prompt: What slide layouts are available in the SAP template? Show me the content-focused layouts.
evals.expected_output: List of available layouts, filtered or highlighted for content layouts

evals.prompt: hey can you make me a quick SAP ppt with like 3 slides - intro, some bullet points, and a thank you at the end?
evals.expected_output: A 3-slide SAP presentation with cover, content, and closing slides

evals.prompt: Extract all the text content from evals/files/sample.pptx
evals.expected_output: Plain text extraction of all slide content
assertions: Text is readable and organized by slide

evals.prompt: Create a presentation using the 'Title and Text: 2 Columns' layout comparing cloud vs on-premise solutions
evals.expected_output: Presentation with a two-column comparison slide
assertions: Topic relates to cloud vs on-premise

evals.prompt: What are the SAP brand colors I should use in my presentation?
evals.expected_output: Information about SAP color palette with hex codes
assertions: Provides hex codes or RGB values

evals.prompt: Delete slide 2 from evals/files/sample.pptx and save the result
assertions: Has one fewer slide than original
